_meta.note: Generic launch prep checklist — not official Rockstar guidance.
_meta.todo: TODO: verify storage / account requirements on official platform docs closer to launch.

items.label: Confirm your Rockstar Games account email and password work
Sign in to PlayStation Network or Xbox account on the console you'll use
Payment method on file (or prepaid balance) if buying digital
If pre-ordering: confirm the order, edition, and platform in your store library
Console powered, updated, and online (PS5 or Xbox Series X|S)
Free storage space ready (exact install size: unconfirmed — TODO: verify on official store)
If using external/expansion storage: confirm it meets your console's game-play requirements
TV/monitor HDMI and console video settings set the way you like
Stable internet for download / day-one patch (speeds vary by region)
Know how to pause other downloads so the game can finish installing
Check unlock time for your timezone (still unconfirmed globally — see Countdown page)
Optional: add friends / party chat ready if you plan to play together
Controller charged (or spare batteries / cable handy)
Water / snacks — long download evenings happen
Mute spoilers on social media if you want a clean first play
